name: DouDB
description: Dou Dizhu card game with 3- and 4-player modes, computer opponents, LAN rooms, and switchable classic/database themes.
releaseNotes: Initial store submission: three/four-player Dou Dizhu, local AI and LAN rooms, modular skins, audio/effects, and responsive DBX panel layout. macOS Apple Silicon; Chinese UI.

zh-CN.name: DouDB · 斗地主
zh-CN.description: 三人/四人斗地主，支持电脑补位、局域网对战、经典与数据库主题切换，以及独立皮肤、音效和背景音乐。
